name: codelens
description: CodeLens - 编程 Agent Web 应用（React + Express 全栈）

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix client && npm run build --prefix server && node scripts/prepare-dist.mjs
scripts.start: npm run install:all && npm run build && node server/dist/app.js
scripts.test: npm test --prefix server && npm test --prefix client
